§6Lead§f

§aSoft, toxic, and essential for everything from circuits to reactor shielding.§f

Lead ore spawns between Y 5 and 35, fairly common at 6 veins per chunk. Smelt it in any furnace. You'll also get lead nuggets as decay products from reactor fuels later on.

Uses are everywhere: §bsoldering§f for circuit production, §bammunition§f, §bradiation protection§f in hazmat suits, §breactor components§f, and a §bLead Anvil§f as an alternative to iron.

Keep a steady supply. It's cheap, you'll burn through it fast once electronics come into play, and it only gets more important as you progress.

§ePS:§f Lead is also used in the Watz and breeding reactors. Plan ahead.
